Description:
Years of dedicated study have yielded results, though the scholarship of the dark arts is not akin to the arcane. Standing before you is a woman who does not manipulate the strings of magic - no, she destroys them, weaving a tunnel of sorts to an unfathomable source of eldrich energy that pulses ominously around her, stirring unease into your soul. Out of nowhere, she laughs, and her features soften into a kind smile directed at you. Despite society's rejection, she is no monster. She, too, is human, with emotions and heart, however dark it may be.
Witchblades are practicioners of the occult or outer magic and techniques beyond the normal domain. Using a blade, fell magic and even stealing powers away from the enemies, each Witchblade has its own source for their powers, by study, persuasiveness or pure chance.
A Witchblade is a spellcaster attuned to the unknown and bizarre, who only needs to rest inbetween fights, and every encounter wakes the power in them anew - this time, sleep is not for the wicked.
Quick Note: A Witchblade is a spellcaster attuned to the unknown and bizarre, who only needs to rest inbetween fights, and every encounter wakes the power in them anew - this time, sleep is not for the wicked.
Weapons: You are Trained in 2 Weapon Categories of choice (e.g. One-Handed Melee, Two-Handed Ranged, Shields, etc).

Mana.Regain: Your Mana reset after every combat.

Spellcasting.Change: You can change your known Spells and Talents inbetween Adventures.
Spellcasting.Other: All Witchblade-specific Abilities are considered Spells.

~Sentient Weapon~.Effect:
You have a Witchblade Weapon - a special weapon of one chosen type (e.g. Shortsword, Longbow, Pike, etc). This weapon will have extra effects later on. Don't lose it!
You gain +1 in Might or Instinct, up to +3.
~Sentient Weapon~.Upgrade: Reposess: By spending 1 hour, you can transfer the curse of your Witchblade Weapon into another weapon. That new weapon becomes your Witchblade Weapon, and the old one is destroyed.
~Sentient Weapon~.Notes:
You are bound by soul to your Witchblade Weapon, inside which your patron's avatar lies, either possessing the weapon, being trapped inside it, cursing it, or using it as a means of communication with you.
You must choose your weapon type when you become a Witchblade Witchblade.
You can customize your weapon's personality, voice, the way it looks. Talk to your Quest Master.
~Sentient Weapon~.Name: ~Sentient Weapon~

~Witchblade~.Effect: After you cast a Spell that costs {Mana}Mana, your next Witchblade Weapon attack deals 1d6 extra Damage (within 5 minutes).
~Witchblade~.Notes: You can only add the 1d6 once per turn. The d6's can stack (from multiple Spells that cost {Mana}Mana, one after another).
~Witchblade~.Name: ~Witchblade~

~Hail~.Effect: Blast a Unit for 2d8 + ^target's Might^ Damage of your chosen Element.
~Hail~.Name: ~Hail~

~Wyrd Renewal~.Effect:
Roll 1d10 - 5. After you see the result, choose a Worthy Unit.
If it's negative, deal Scourge Damage to it. Otherwise, Heal it.
~Wyrd Renewal~.Name: ~Wyrd Renewal~

~Deathfire Flame~.Effect: Shoot a bolt of deathly fire in a 1x10 meter line. All Units it touches take 1d6 + 1d8 + 1d10 Scourge or Fire Damage (your choice).
~Deathfire Flame~.Name: ~Deathfire Flame~

~Curse of Weakness~.Effect: Choose a Unit. The first time it deals Damage on its every Turn, roll 1d4 and subtract it from its dealt Damage.
~Curse of Weakness~.Upgrade: Only affects an Epic monster's first turn.
~Curse of Weakness~.Name: ~Curse of Weakness~

~Curse of Pain~.Effect: Choose a Unit. At the start of each of your Turns, it takes 1d4 Scourge Damage (ignoring Cover).
~Curse of Pain~.Name: ~Curse of Pain~

~Psyche Blast~.Effect:
A Unit takes 4d6 Psychic Damage and chooses whether to become Blinded or Silenced.
Apply a ~Combo~ to it.
~Psyche Blast~.Notes:
Cover is applied normally.

A Blind Unit's next Damage/Heal Act deals -50% Damage/Healing.
A Silenced Unit can't use Abilities.
~Psyche Blast~.Name: ~Psyche Blast~

~Disenchantment~.Effect: A person you can see must pass a Presence Roll against your Presence Roll or have -2 to non-combat Rolls, and be afflicted by minor curse effects (e.g. is clumsy, stumbles, get pimples, etc).
~Disenchantment~.Notes: Be creative with the effects of the minor curse effects!
~Disenchantment~.Name: ~Disenchantment~

~Compel~.Duration: Lasts until they can't see/hear you
~Compel~.Effect: Choose a Unit you can see. You have +1d2 to Presence Rolls against it.
~Compel~.Notes: The target can't tell it was affected unless it knows about this type of magic.
~Compel~.Name: ~Compel~

~Oculus~.Effect:
You conjure a magical eye that records everything it sees. It can be a Tuner Eye or Recording Eye.
At will, a Tuner Eye allows you to see what it sees, live, in your mind.
A Recording Eye records everything it sees. You can retrieve it to see everything recorded in it.
~Oculus~.Name: ~Oculus~

~Thaumaturgy~.Effect:
You create one of the following magical effects:
{Diamond} Your voice booms up to three times as loud as normal for 1 minute.
{Diamond} You cause flames to flicker, brighten, dim, or change color for 1 minute.
{Diamond} You cause harmless tremors in the ground for 1 minute.
{Diamond} You cause an unlocked door or window to fly open or slam shut.
{Diamond} You alter the appearance of your eyes for 1 minute.
~Thaumaturgy~.Upgrade: At Level 4 you can cast this for 1 {A}Action Point, and at Level 7, for 0 {A}Action Points.
~Thaumaturgy~.Name: ~Thaumaturgy~

<Shapeshifting Weapon>.Effect: Instantly change the type of weapon of your Witchblade Weapon.
<Shapeshifting Weapon>.Name: <Shapeshifting Weapon>

<Curseweave>.Effect: After you attack a Worthy Enemy with your Witchblade Weapon, if your next Act is a Damaging Spell that costs {Mana}Mana, it deals +1d6 Damage (within 5 minutes).
<Curseweave>.Notes: Applies to Mass Damage, but only applies once to Spells that hit multiple times (e.g. Magic Missile-like Spells, Damage over time effects, etc).
<Curseweave>.Name: <Curseweave>

<Cursehelix>.Effect: You now have 1 more Witchblade Weapon, of any kind. The same patron or another one of the same type is possessing your second weapon.
<Cursehelix>.Upgrade: Once per turn, for 0 {A}Action Points, you can vanish or resummon one of them.
<Cursehelix>.Name: <Cursehelix>

<Hungering Weapon>.Effect: When ^you^ drop a Worthy Enemy to 0 Health, gain an extra 1 {A}Action Point this turn and 5 Shielding.
<Hungering Weapon>.Name: <Hungering Weapon>

<Spell Tap>.Effect: Every Worthy Combat, the moment you drop to 0 {Mana}Mana, gain Shielding equal to your Max {Mana}Mana and you can immediately freely (for 0 {A}Action Points) cast a Spell that doesn't cost {Mana}Mana.
<Spell Tap>.Name: <Spell Tap>

<Somatic Pulse>.Effect:
^Count^ the Worthy Units within 3 meters of you (including you).
They all take Pulse Damage equal to ^Counted^ d4 (except you).
<Somatic Pulse>.Notes: E.g. if this affects 3 Units, it deals 3d4. If it affects 4 Units, it deals 4d4. 5 Units - 5d4. And so on.
<Somatic Pulse>.Name: <Somatic Pulse>

~Dancing Blade~.Effect:
Your melee weapon Attacks have +1 meter range, by levitating to your target, hitting them, then quickly returning to your hand.
You also have +1 Movement Speed
~Dancing Blade~.Notes:
These Attacks are still considered melee Attacks, and are not considered thrown.
Flanking applies normally if there's an Ally right behind the enemy you're Attacking (forming a line between the 3 of you).
~Dancing Blade~.Name: ~Dancing Blade~

~Speak With Objects~.Effect: Choose a willing, non-hostile object. Think of an idea or question. The object responds in a way only you understand, based on its memory formed through its wear and tear.
~Speak With Objects~.Notes: Keep in mind that object communication is not like talking to a sentient person - it is more akin to analyzing its wear and tear and getting an enhanced idea or impression of an event it went through.
~Speak With Objects~.Name: ~Speak With Objects~
